approach: Root cause: the guard learns why an attempt stopped from a free-text closing-reason prefix, kept in two places that disagree (`scope_guard::ENVIRONMENT_PREFIX` and `disk::is_environment_reason`, which lists only LOW_DISK and CHECK_TIMEOUT). A producer that dies on an expired login is closed as "the producer did not complete: ... 401 OAuth access token has expired". That reads as a work failure, so it counts as line spend and attempts, and the pause file written then is never rechecked. Fix: (1) in `disk.rs`, add one classifier, `StopCause::of(reason)`, the only place that decides which closing reasons are environment stops. It recognises the `environment:` prefix (low disk, check timeout, producer login expired, usage limit) and the older producer-stop text whose detail names an auth or usage-limit failure, so already-recorded jobs are re-read correctly. `is_environment_reason` and `resumable_stop` become thin users of it. (2) In `producer.rs`, a producer that stops on auth or usage limit is closed with an `environment:` reason from a helper in `disk.rs`. (3) In `scope_guard.rs`, drop `ENVIRONMENT_PREFIX`; add a pure `verdict_of(JobState, Option<&str>)` that uses the classifier, called by `attempt_of`; factor the signal evaluation out of `try_watch_line` into a helper shared with `line_pause`, which recomputes signals from the line's attempts under the current rule and returns the stored pause only while the overall level is still Pause. `status` shows only marks that still hold.

decisions.choice: One typed classifier `StopCause::of(&str)` in disk.rs; `is_environment_reason`, `resumable_stop` and the guard's `verdict_of` all call it. `scope_guard::ENVIRONMENT_PREFIX` is removed and the prefix constant moves to disk.rs.
decisions.reason: The fault is two lists that disagree. A single definition makes the class impossible: a new environment kind is added once and both the guard and retry see it. disk.rs already owns the reason texts and `resumable_stop`.

rejected.option: Add the 401 text to `is_environment_reason` and leave the guard's own prefix check
rejected.why: Keeps two lists and fixes one instance.

rejected.option: Add a stored stop-reason field to a record such as the outcome
rejected.why: Needs a record schema and round-trip changes, and old records would lack it. The closing reason already carries the cause.

decisions.choice: Classify both the new `environment:` reasons and the older text ("the producer did not complete: <detail>" with an auth or usage-limit detail).
decisions.reason: Pauses and attempts are recomputed from stored records, and the 401 jobs are already stored under the old text. Without the old-text rule, recomputing would still count them.

rejected.option: Only write the new prefix in producer.rs
rejected.why: Existing records stay misclassified and the recomputed pause would still hold for them.

decisions.choice: Compute the pause on read: `line_pause` re-evaluates the line's attempts and ignores a stored pause whose signals no longer reach Pause. The file is not deleted or edited.
decisions.reason: Fixes stale pauses after a rule change without a migration. The brief puts editing pause files out of scope, and the pause stays valid for real repeated rejections.

rejected.option: Delete the pause file when the signals clear
rejected.why: Out of scope and loses the record.

rejected.option: Store a rule version in the pause
rejected.why: Needs a new mark field and a version policy; recomputing needs neither.

decisions.choice: Split `attempt_of` so `verdict_of(state, reason)` is a pure function, and move signal evaluation into a helper that `try_watch_line` and `line_pause` share.
decisions.reason: Tests drive real closing reasons through the production mapping without building JobRecords. The write path and read path cannot drift apart, including the same p90 forecast.

rejected.why: Heavy and brittle; the existing Rig covers the end-to-end path.

decisions.choice: Leave `run/mod.rs` unchanged unless the build needs it; `settle_resume_marks` already calls `is_environment_reason`.
decisions.reason: It picks up the new classifier with no edit. A producer stop leaves no resume mark, so `athena retry` re-plans from the base, which `resume_seed` already handles.

files.purpose: Add `ENVIRONMENT_PREFIX`, reason constants for producer auth and usage limit, `StopCause` with `StopCause::of`, `producer_stop_reason(detail)`; rewrite `is_environment_reason`/`resumable_stop` on top of them; update module doc and tests.

Remove `ENVIRONMENT_PREFIX`; add `verdict_of`; use it in `attempt_of`; factor signal evaluation out of `try_watch_line`; make `line_pause` recompute and ignore stale pauses; add a live-marks helper for status; new tests; fix tests that relied on stored pauses or the removed constant.
Close an auth or usage-limit producer stop with an `environment:` reason via `disk::producer_stop_reason`.
Show only marks that still hold under the current rule.
Unreleased entry naming the root cause and the fix.

steps: disk.rs: add `pub const ENVIRONMENT_PREFIX = "environment:"`, `PRODUCER_AUTH` ("environment: producer login expired") and `USAGE_LIMIT` ("environment: usage limit reached"). Add `enum StopCause { LowDisk, CheckTimeout, ProducerAuth, UsageLimit, OtherEnvironment, Work }` with `StopCause::of(reason)` and `is_environment()`. `of` handles the `environment:` prefix and the older 'the producer did not complete: <detail>' text with auth or usage-limit markers. Add `producer_stop_reason(detail) -> String`. Rewrite `is_environment_reason` as `StopCause::of(reason).is_environment()`. Keep `resumable_stop`; update doc comments, including the module doc paragraph on environment stops.

disk.rs tests: update tests that name `scope_guard::ENVIRONMENT_PREFIX`. Add tests for each StopCause kind, the older 401 text, negative cases, `one_classifier_decides_environment_reasons`, and `resumable_stop` on an expired-login stop (criteria 2 and 5).

scope_guard.rs: delete `ENVIRONMENT_PREFIX`; fix its doc references in `Verdict::Environment` and replace the test `the_environment_prefix_is_the_low_disk_prefix` with a check that LOW_DISK, CHECK_TIMEOUT, PRODUCER_AUTH and USAGE_LIMIT all classify as environment. Add `pub(crate) fn verdict_of(state: JobState, reason: Option<&str>) -> Option<Verdict>` using `StopCause::of`; make `attempt_of` call it.

scope_guard.rs: add a private helper `line_state(records, requests, line) -> (Vec<AttemptRecord>, f64, Signals)` holding the p90 lookup and `evaluate_before_attempt` now inline in `try_watch_line`; make `try_watch_line` use it. Change `line_pause` to read the mark and return it only when the recomputed `overall()` is `Level::Pause`. Add `Athena::live_marks(&self, records) -> Vec<LineMark>` that filters `list_lines` to marks that still hold (a pause needs Pause; a flag needs at least Flag; an unknown line is kept). Update the module doc to say pauses are computed, not trusted.

producer.rs: replace the format string at the 'the producer did not complete' failure with `crate::disk::producer_stop_reason(&record.detail.clone().unwrap_or_default())`. Leave the timeout branch and other failure texts alone.

scope_guard.rs tests: add the criterion 3 tests (four-attempt auth line with a work-failure control, and the all-kinds table); add the criterion 4 Rig tests (stale hand-written pause ignored, natural T4 pause kept, retry not blocked by the stale one, status omits the stale mark). Fix `retry_refuses_paused_line` as described in the risks.

status.rs: change the `list_lines(&self.state)` call (around line 1759) and the `lines` field fill to `self.live_marks(&records)`. Check that `status().lines` and the 'is paused' next-step lines come from the filtered list.
CHANGELOG.md: add an Unreleased entry naming the root cause and the fix. Do not touch athena.toml, defaults.toml or any workflow.

Run `cargo fmt --all`, then `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked`. Fix any test or doc link that named the removed constant (a Grep of `ENVIRONMENT_PREFIX` should show only disk.rs).

risks.risk: Detail-text markers for auth and usage limit are too broad and a real work failure is classed as environment, so a runaway line is never paused.
risks.mitigation: Match auth only on specific phrases (an 'oauth ... expired' or 'token has expired' phrase, 'authentication_error', or '401' together with 'unauthorized', 'authenticat' or 'token'). Match the older text only when the reason starts with 'the producer did not complete: '. Add negative tests for ordinary failures (no valid report, a compile error that mentions 401, a verifier rejection).

risks.risk: Recomputing in `line_pause` breaks existing tests that write a hand-made pause for a line whose attempts do not reach Pause (`retry_refuses_paused_line` uses different-criterion rejections).
risks.mitigation: Change those tests to a real pause (script [Some(0), Some(0)]) and delete the pause file for the control step, as `t4_pause_via_go_and_ask` does. `status_lists_flagged_and_paused_lines` stays valid because its marks name lines not in the records; an unknown line keeps its mark.

risks.risk: `line_pause` uses a different p90 forecast than `try_watch_line`, so a T3 pause could flip.
risks.mitigation: Both use one shared helper that reads the forecast from the latest request of the line.

risks.risk: A producer stop on auth leaves no resume mark, so `athena retry` might be expected to resume a candidate that does not exist.
risks.mitigation: `resume_seed` with no mark starts from the base. The criterion 5 test checks only `resumable_stop`; the step 6 test also confirms the settle step spends no mark.

demonstrations.method: Content check: read the doc comment on `StopCause` in disk.rs, the module doc of scope_guard.rs, and the CHANGELOG.md entry; the root cause is stated there.
demonstrations.observes: The diff names the root cause: stop reason inferred from free-text closing-reason prefixes in two disagreeing lists, so an auth-expiry stop counted as line spend; the fix is the shared classifier in disk.rs and scope_guard.rs.

demonstrations.method: Test plus Grep. A test in disk.rs asserts `is_environment_reason(r) == StopCause::of(r).is_environment()` and `resumable_stop` agrees, for each kind. A Grep of `ENVIRONMENT_PREFIX` and `starts_with("environment:")` under crates/ shows the definition only in disk.rs (and tests).
demonstrations.observes: The test passes; the Grep shows a single definition of which closing reasons are environment stops, and `attempt_of`, `is_environment_reason` and `resumable_stop` reach it.

demonstrations.method: Unit tests in scope_guard.rs `mod tests`. Test A: map the producer-auth-expired closing reason, in both the new `environment:` form and the older text "the producer did not complete: ... 401 OAuth access token has expired", through `verdict_of(JobState::Closed(OutcomeState::Failed), Some(reason))` for four attempts of 40 minutes and $1.50 each. Build `AttemptRecord`s with the existing `att` helper and assert `evaluate_before_attempt(&attempts, 2.0)` gives Level::None for t1, t3 and t5. Control: a work failure ("the producer returned no valid report") on the same four attempts gives t1 Flag and t5 Pause. Test B: a table over every environment kind (low disk via `LowDisk::text`, `check_timeout_reason`, producer auth, usage limit via `disk::producer_stop_reason`) asserts each maps to Verdict::Environment and raises no signal.
demonstrations.observes: The auth-expired line raises no signal at t1, t3 or t5; the control line does; every environment kind is Verdict::Environment, not one job's text.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the classifier change the older 401 text maps to Verdict::Failed; t1 flags at the third attempt and t5 reaches Pause at 120 minutes, so test A fails. The usage-limit and auth rows of test B fail as well.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry points `scope_guard::verdict_of` (added in step 3) and `evaluate_before_attempt` (exists, read in scope_guard.rs). Input is real closing-reason text built from the production constants and helpers (`LowDisk::text`, `check_timeout_reason`, `disk::producer_stop_reason` added in step 1). No fake; the `att` helper in `mod tests` exists today.

demonstrations.method: Rig tests in scope_guard.rs `watcher_tests`, using the existing `rig`, `two_rejections`, `write_mark`, `pause_path` and `Athena::line_pause`. Test 1: `rig(0.8, 0.01, &[Some(0), Some(1)])` gives two rejections of different criteria; write a hand-made T4 pause with `mark("pause", ...)` and assert `line_pause` is None and `retry` is not refused. Test 2: `rig(0.8, 0.01, &[Some(0), Some(0)])` pauses naturally on the same criterion twice and `line_pause` returns Some and refuses the retry. Test 3: `status().lines` omits the stale mark and keeps the real one.
demonstrations.observes: A stale stored pause is not returned and does not block the retry; a pause for real repeated rejections is returned and refuses the retry.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the recompute, `line_pause` returns the stored file as-is, so test 1 sees Some(pause) and the retry is refused.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry points `Athena::line_pause`, `Athena::retry` and `Athena::status`. The fake driver rig (`watcher_tests::rig`, `FakeAgentDriver`) exists today; it is injected as the Athena agent driver by `rig`. The shared signal helper that `line_pause` recomputes with is added in step 4. The hand-written pause file is the stored state under test, not the logic.

demonstrations.method: Unit tests in disk.rs `mod tests`: `resumable_stop(JobState::Closed(OutcomeState::Failed), Some(reason))` is true for the older text "the producer did not complete: ... 401 OAuth access token has expired" and for `producer_stop_reason` output of an auth or usage-limit detail. It is false for "the producer returned no valid report", an admission refusal, and Rejected or Landed states.
demonstrations.observes: An expired-login producer stop is resumable by `athena retry`, and work failures are not.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the change `is_environment_reason` only matches LOW_DISK and CHECK_TIMEOUT, so the 401 reason is not resumable and the first assertion fails.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry points `disk::resumable_stop` (exists) and `disk::producer_stop_reason` (added in step 1). Plain strings and the existing JobState and OutcomeState enums; no double.

demonstrations.method: Run the three Athena checks as separate whole commands: `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`, and `cargo test --locked` (the command given). The full test run executes the whole workspace suite, including the new disk and scope_guard tests of steps 2 and 6 and the existing tests updated in steps 2, 3 and 6 that named the removed `ENVIRONMENT_PREFIX` or wrote hand-made pauses.
demonstrations.observes: All three checks pass: formatting is clean, clippy reports no warning, and every test in the workspace passes, including the new tests that exercise the classifier and the recomputed pause.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the change the new criterion 3, 4 and 5 tests fail, so `cargo test --locked` fails. A partial change also fails: removing `ENVIRONMENT_PREFIX` without updating its users breaks compilation, and recomputing the pause without fixing the hand-made-pause tests (`retry_refuses_paused_line`) fails them.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry points are the cargo workspace commands themselves, which run every test through the real code paths named in criteria 3 to 5. No fake or fixture of their own; the fake driver rig and in-module helpers are the ones listed in those demonstrations. The seam exists today (the cargo workspace and the test modules); the new tests are added by steps 2 and 6.

demonstrations.method: Show that the diff touches no governance file.
demonstrations.observes: No athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflow file appears; only crates/athena-core/src files and CHANGELOG.md change.

open_questions: The exact text the agent driver puts in `record.detail` for a usage-limit stop is not in the repository. The producer should keep the markers conservative (lower-case substring: 'usage limit', 'rate limit', 'rate_limit', 'quota') unless the real text is found.
Whether an old record's detail is exactly the sentence in the incident ("401 OAuth access token has expired") is taken from the brief, not from a stored record.
`TimedOut` producer stops (mod.rs `keep_timed_out_work`) still count as work in the guard. That is a different cause, not listed in the brief, so it is left as is.
